response.rationale: CNS toxoplasmosis is more likely than Primary CNS lymphoma in an immunocompromised patient with a very low CD4 count (6 cells/mm^3) and multiple enhancing nodular white matter lesions. While both can present with similar imaging findings, toxoplasmosis is more common with such severe immunosuppression. Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy is contradicted by the presence of enhancing lesions.
